column3: NASB follows the critical text; “from a year ago” is rendered “since last year,” and “has been provoking the greater number” is “has stirred up most of them.”
NASB renders “made void” as “made empty” and “matter” as “case.”
NASB follows the critical text without “of boasting”; the aside is set off with dashes.
NASB follows the critical text (“previously promised”); “exhort” is rendered “urge,” and “blessing” is “bountiful gift.”
NASB adds “I say” and renders “upon blessings” as “bountifully.”
NASB follows the critical text (“has purposed”); it adds “Let … do” and renders “out of regret” as “grudgingly” and “of necessity” as “under compulsion.”
NASB follows the critical text (“is able”); it renders “abound in every good work” as “have an abundance for every good deed.”
The quotation is in capitals; “to the age” is rendered “FOREVER.”
NASB follows the critical text with future verbs; “fruits” is rendered “harvest.”
NASB renders “enriching” as “you will be enriched” and “generosity” as “liberality.”
NASB renders “completely filling up” as “fully supplying.”
NASB restructures the verse; “submission” is rendered “obedience,” and “participation” is “contribution.”
NASB renders “supplication” as “prayer” and “a longing” as “yearn,” adding “while.”
